elements.text: WIF Desk — BD Team Trial Guide
Bot: @grokfomotrading_bot  ·  Chain: Robinhood Chain (EVM, chain ID 4663)  ·  Mode: PAPER trading (virtual cash, no real funds)
1. Start the bot
Open the bot link above and tap Start (or send /start).
You'll get: WIF Desk online. Robinhood Chain trading agent. Commands: /scan /status /trade /portfolio /practice /mode
2. Run a scan
/scan
The Scanner agent pulls live Robinhood Chain tokens (DexScreener + on-chain pool logs) and feeds them through the full pipeline: Scanner → Auditor → Analyst → Executor → Risk.
You'll see a numbered list, e.g. 1. Robinhood (ROBINHOOD) — 0x008Df4...  2. Robinhood (ROBINHOOD) — 0x79Fe86...
3. Set up your practice wallet
/practice  — resets your virtual balance to $1,000.
You can also set a custom amount: /practice 5000
4. Buy a token
Use the number from the /scan list: /trade 1 50
Or use a percentage of your cash: /trade 1 25%

The Auditor (contract / liquidity / pool age / holders) and Analyst (alive / organic / flush / chase score) run before the trade. If a token fails the gates, the bot tells you why. Add force to override: /trade 1 50 force
After buying you'll see buttons: Close 15% · Close 50% · Close All · View on DexScreener
5. Manage positions
· Close part of a trade — tap Close 15%, Close 50%, or Close All
· Close by command — /close 1 (100%) or /close 1 50 (50%)
· View portfolio — /portfolio (cash + open positions)
· View PnL — /pnl (report + bar-chart image of every trade)
6. Other commands

rows: Scan for tokens, run the full pipeline

elements.text: 7. How the 5-agent pipeline works
1. Scanner — finds new tokens on Robinhood Chain
2. Auditor — 4-layer safety check (contract, liquidity, pool age, top holders)
3. Analyst — scores momentum/organic activity (rules-based)
4. Executor — sizes the position, pushes Buy/Skip to Telegram
5. Risk — stop-loss (6%), trailing stop (12% after +20%), timeout (3h), PnL exits
Every trade is paper-only. No real funds move.
8. Notes
· Your wallet/positions are stored server-side and survive restarts.
· Trade alerts are broadcast to everyone who /starts the bot.
· The bot runs on Robinhood Chain mainnet data.
· Built for the World is Flat Hackathon (Agents & AI category).
